name: Finite-overlap binary first-value identification
status: fixed before execution; theoretical and implementation checks precede outcomes
primary: Normalized oriented frame error after recovering r=P^T a and H(r), followed by ordinary ambient polar projection.
comparator: Original value-orthogonal polar estimator applied without overlap correction; identical noisy first-value labels and examples.
secondary: Clean parity and terminal prediction errors on six-step adaptive Gaussian paths; all fixed sample counts, seeds, and overlaps reported.
quadrature: 128-point Gauss-Jacobi for the spherical first-coordinate law; deterministic bracketed radial inverse; checks against 64 points.
selection: No fit selection, reruns based on outcomes, tuning on test data, or claim of a finite-overlap SQ exponent.
evidence: Full test inputs, clean paths, both estimators, per-example predictions, cumulative first/value-weighted moments, RNG states, and first 128 raw training observations per seed. Full training stream is reproducible from fixed RNG and code.
